# Improving Revenue Through Recall Campaigns

Improving Revenue Through Recall Campaigns  
By Dr. Liana Mercer, Clinic Operations Lead  

Last year, BrightSmile Dental faced a persistent challenge: low appointment adherence among patients due for preventive care. Despite sending standard annual reminders, only 52% of patients scheduled their follow-ups, which directly impacted chair utilization and the accuracy of insurance claims.

To address this, our team launched Project RecallPlus, a targeted outreach campaign leveraging patient segmentation and personalized communication. Instead of generic messages, patients were grouped by factors like last visit date, treatment history, and insurance provider. We then sent tailored reminders—via SMS or email—highlighting the importance of timely check-ups and clarifying coverage benefits. For example, patients with pending cleanings received a message emphasizing the risk of gum disease progression and a clear breakdown of out-of-pocket costs under their plan.

Within six months, appointment adherence rose to 78%, improving chair utilization from 62% to 85%. This boost not only enhanced revenue flow but also streamlined billing accuracy; insurance claims matched scheduled services more consistently, reducing denials by 30%.

Our key recommendation: invest in data-driven recall campaigns with personalized messaging. This approach fosters patient engagement, ensures consistent preventive care, and directly supports the clinic’s financial health. BrightSmile’s experience proves that smart recall strategies are a powerful lever for growth in dental practices.
